steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Quality control (QC) ensures manufactured products meet design specifications through inspection and testing. | Key Fact: Tolerances define the permissible variation from a nominal dimension: critical dimensions have tighter tolerances. | Key Fact: Vernier calipers measure internal, external and depth dimensions to 0.02 mm resolution. | Key Fact: Micrometers measure external dimensions to 0.01 mm resolution using a precision screw thread.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from quality control in manufacturing, and one past-paper question.
